blocking_gate.closes_when: a reviewed engineering item lands the guard change with a test that composes candidate_supply and a later-phase plain phase_supply on one phase, and the E3 fragments' source-receipt root is corrected. Then: prepare-supply the three cells, pin prepared_phase_supply and the preparation readiness requirement, recompute the composed and protocol hashes, re-pin this package, and re-run check.
blocking_gate.diagnosed_sufficient_change: Narrowing the guard to first-phase explicit specs, i.e. collisions = ({phase for phase in specs if phase == first_phase} | scoped_phases).intersection(candidate_specs), was verified in a throwaway tree to be sufficient for construction and for a model-free prepare-supply of all three B1 cells. It is NOT applied in this repository: it is a production change that owes its own reviewed engineering item and its own test, and rails.knowledge_stores is one of the five module files whose SHA-256 the prepared phase-supply artifact pins, so any artifact prepared against an unreviewed patch would be invalid the moment that patch is reshaped in review.
blocking_gate.refusal: rails.knowledge_stores.build_knowledge_store_supply: 'candidate, explicit, and scoped supply cannot overlap on phase(s) [solver]'
blocking_gate.second_defect: The committed E3 fragments also carry a preparation_source_receipts pin with 'root': 'repo'; core.preparation.verify_source_receipts accepts only 'repository' and 'data' and refuses the pin as malformed. The three B1 fragments registered here use 'repository'; the three committed E3 fragments still need the same correction.
blocking_gate.where: src/speech_aware_evidence_acquisition/rails/knowledge_stores.py, the per-store collision guard immediately after load_phase_supply_specs
blocking_gate.why: The slot-contracts store serves the Solver phase through candidate_supply and the E3 train-exemplars store serves the same phase through phase_supply. The E3 commit cfdf08fb added the composition that routes a later-phase plain phase_supply into automatic_for_phase and names this exact pairing in its own module comment, but left the older collision guard that refuses it, and covered only the context_supply pairing with a test. The refusal is therefore inherited: the committed anchor-based configs/baseline/slurp-native-dual-store-train-fold-a-exemplars-k20-v1.json reproduces it identically.

decision_rule.primary: official pooled SLU micro F1 (slurp-slu-official-train), natural mixture

resampling.sensitivity: paired scenario-stratified row bootstrap, same draws and seed

verdict.ADMITTED: the CI95 lower bound of the pooled SLU delta is greater than 0 against the base AND against the twin, intent is non-inferior within 0.92 pp, the normalised scorer agrees in sign, and no scenario loses intent beyond the null band
verdict.HARMFUL: otherwise, when a guard fails on the losing side
verdict.NEUTRAL: otherwise, and it enters the default plan only if it lowers cost

failure_policy: Stop and preserve on the first failure. No automatic restart, replay, row filtering, roster/role-graph/prompt/geometry/cap change or silent recovery. At most one root-diagnosed recovery re-registration per run; a second failure closes that flight and the fix must be proven on a four-row dry run first. A failed four-row smoke stops cell B1 until the fix is proven on that same four-row roster.
